findings.quote: The problem is that glycolysis turns NAD+ into NADH, and the cell runs out of NAD+.
findings.problem: Round-1 L22a is still open. This fermentation paragraph has five sentences, over the limit of one to three. Other paragraphs also run long: the electron paragraph (five), the paragraph beginning 'One glucose gives only' (five), and the prokaryote, organelle, enzyme-pH, anaerobic respiration and 'Photosynthesis happens only in cells with chloroplasts' paragraphs (four each).
